name: dialog-refusal-fallback
notes: hand-written from the 2.1.257 bundle modules; shapes unconfirmed on 2.1.259
no process ran, so launch is empty and exit_code is null
message uuids are readable synthetic ids, not RFC 4122 uuids; the bundle types these fields as uuids
timestamps are synthetic deltas chosen so a replay is quick, not measured intervals
transcript/ holds the session's user and assistant messages as delivered; whether the CLI removes a tombstoned or superseded message from its own history file is unknown and unmodelled
the tombstone frame's message field is opaque in the bundle schema; only the tombstoned uuid is carried
the result subtype on the decline legs is this fixture's assumption, not a bundle reading
the 1.5s gap before the CLI retires the undeclared-kind dialog stands in for the dialog park deadline, which the parent's investigation records as five minutes by default
system/model_refusal_no_fallback is deliberately absent: its schema says it is not emitted when the user declined the retry dialog
prompts: prompt that triggers an undeclared kind
purpose: every refusal_fallback_prompt result, the close path, the tombstones and supersedes after a refusal, an undeclared kind cancelled by the CLI
